products.name: Darktrace
products.note: Self-learning AI security; anomaly detection; autonomous response; UK-hosted; GDPR relevant

profile_text.body:
Darktrace describes itself as an AI cybersecurity platform built around what it calls Adaptive AI, which learns from an organization's own data to establish a baseline of normal behavior rather than being trained on large shared datasets from other organizations. The company says this approach allows its systems to detect subtle anomalies and novel threats, including AI-driven attacks, across email, cloud environments, critical infrastructure, and other enterprise assets. It states that its AI can interrupt in-progress attacks, including ransomware and email phishing, within seconds.

The company's core product is a unified platform offering continuous behavioral monitoring and autonomous response across an organization's people, infrastructure, and AI systems. Darktrace describes itself as a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Email Security Platforms, citing AI-native protection and integrations as distinguishing features. It is also noted as introducing a solution combining real-time security awareness coaching with adaptive AI protection.

The held facts list Darktrace's product under the Security and Identity AI category, noting self-learning AI security, anomaly detection, autonomous response, UK hosting, and GDPR relevance. No litigation, SEC filings, MCP servers, or patent records are present in the available data.
